upstream.drop_when: Replace when mainline Linux provides a Synaptics TouchComm v2 (TCM2) SPI driver supporting S3930TB0A0 full-duplex GPI DMA transfers and dynamic CMD_GET_TOUCH_REPORT_CONFIG parsing.
Drop once upstream arch/arm64/boot/dts/qcom/ includes sm8750-nubia-np05j board support.
Drop if NP05J packages its board calibration directly as ath12k/WCN7850/hw2.0/board.bin or upstream ath12k Peach board_api1 lookup supports bdwlan.eXX.
Drop once the shared arm-smmu Qualcomm handoff patch caps smmu->num_mapping_groups to QCOM_HANDOFF_MAX_SMR on platforms reporting >128 SMR groups.
Drop once upstream Linux adds NXP TFA9874 ASoC codec support and nubia,np05j-sndcard Primary MI2S matching.
Drop once upstream Linux drivers/gpu/drm/panel/ includes Himax HX8874 Dual-DSI DSC OLED panel support.
Drop once upstream drivers/gpu/drm/msm/msm_mdss.c enables MDSS clocks around msm_mdss_reset() so continuous splash is cleanly reset on SM8750.
Drop once upstream drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_hw_top.c stops writing legacy SW_TRG_MUX bits on DPU 8.0+ and uses SMART_PANEL_ALIGN_MODE for split command-mode panels.
